title: Clone headroom: per-agent non-cone sparse-checkout excluding monitor/integrity/ bulk + stale-clone pre-clean at agent startup + tinker cleanup window 24h→4h
problem_statement: Working tree is ~401 MB of which monitor/integrity/ is ~342 MB / 1,021 tracked files (85%) — high-churn per-run sentinels draining over 7-10 days post-PROP-082, but even post-drain every cloning agent pays for a directory it never reads. Separately, stale clones survive crashes for hours (24h cleanup window too wide; 2026-06-06 evidence: 208 MB /tmp/tinker-clone survived a crashed run) on a 9.6 GB root partition that has hit 100% twice with decider-degradation consequences.

sparse_enabled.decider: clone-create in reference/decider-patches-and-selfapply.md; clone-reuse safe (sparse config persists; invocation idempotent on every pass per PROP-083 pattern)
sparse_enabled.curmudgeon: fresh clone each run in curmudgeon.md Step 0
sparse_enabled.analyst + analyst-baby: shared Step 0a in analyst.md (baby inherits by reference); applies only when a clone exists — Step 0a is refresh-only and never creates

excluded_with_reason.dome-mirror: prompt-level safety rule bans partial-clone shapes (PROP-074/PROP-051 lineage); has a working-tree population check (<100 files → abort) that sparse could trip; sync-workspace-step4c.js READS monitor/integrity/sync-workspace-runs-*.json from the clone as its core last-sync signal — excluding them would break no-op detection. Also: B2 pre-clean already existed in dome-mirror.md (lines ~88-89); no edit needed.
excluded_with_reason.poller: does not clone — reads dome site + writes FUSE workspace only
excluded_with_reason.social: does not clone — writes monitor/social/drafts/ on FUSE; decider commits
excluded_with_reason.workspace-sync: directive non-goal; PROP-051 safety gate A1
excluded_with_reason.integrity, prune-integrity, tinker: write monitor/integrity/ — need the full directory

decider: monitor/integrity/prop-009-shadow.jsonl (decider.md:935 — APPEND from clone; must be materialized)
WRITES new files only: verify-pending-run-*.json / push-failure-*.json — untracked-new-file commits work in sparse-excluded dirs

design.mechanism: git sparse-checkout init --no-cone + gitignore-style patterns in .git/info/sparse-checkout. Non-cone is required because re-includes are file-level (report-*.json inside an excluded dir). Pattern shape: '/*' then '!/monitor/integrity/*' (contents-exclusion, NOT dir-exclusion, so file re-includes work per gitignore semantics) then per-agent re-includes.
design.no_filter_blob_none: Deliberately NOT used — PROP-051 disaster vector, directive non-goal. Savings are working-tree-only; the ~30 MB .git pack still carries all blobs.
design.helper_script: monitor/scripts/clone-hygiene.sh — single shared script, two subcommands (preclean, sparse), per-agent patterns centralized. Follows the proven helper-extraction pattern (push-via-api.js PROP-050, sync-workspace-step4c.js PROP-066, audit-rewrite.js PROP-041) to minimize per-prompt LOC and LLM skip-by-omission risk.
design.fail_open: Every sparse error path leaves the clone FULL and exits 0 — sparse is an optimization, never a correctness gate. Unknown agent names are refused (left full).

deviations_from_directive: Pre-clean /sessions scope narrowed to the CURRENT session's dome-*-clone dirs only (directive asked for /sessions/*). Cross-session deletion could race a live agent's clone, and directory mtime is an unreliable liveness signal (git operations on .git may not touch the top-level dir mtime). /tmp/*-clone sweep is universal as directed.

analyst added to sparse-eligible alongside analyst-baby: the directive listed analyst-baby; both share analyst.md Step 0a, and analyst's read-surface for monitor/integrity/ is empty, so one edit covers both.
dome-mirror dropped from Part A scope per the directive's own escape hatch (prohibition discovered in Step A1 — see scope_table.excluded_with_reason).

validation.method: local file:// simulation clone of /tmp/tinker-clone (HEAD 5a0316e), per-agent pattern applied, files + worktree measured
validation.preclean_functional_test: stale (3h mtime) /tmp/stale-test-clone removed; fresh sibling and own clone untouched — PASS 2026-06-07
validation.note: post-PROP-082 drain will shrink the absolute savings; steady-state exclusion still removes the highest-churn directory from 4 clone surfaces

files_touched: CLAUDE.md (per-session clone discipline rewrite of item 4 tail)
self_apply_rationale: Directive pre-approves self-apply at <150 LOC across prompt edits; all edits are additive, fail-open, and operator pre-approved the broad strokes in the directive's operator_decision block.
verification_pattern: grep -l 'clone-hygiene.sh' monitor/prompts/curmudgeon.md monitor/prompts/curmudgeon-verify.md monitor/prompts/analyst.md monitor/prompts/reference/decider-patches-and-selfapply.md monitor/prompts/tinker.md | wc -l (expect 5) && test -x monitor/scripts/clone-hygiene.sh && sh -n monitor/scripts/clone-hygiene.sh && grep -q 'mtime older than 4h' monitor/prompts/tinker.md && ! grep -q 'mtime older than 24h' monitor/prompts/tinker.md  # NOTE: plain 'older than 24h' still appears in tinker.md's stranded-PATCHES section — unrelated to clones, deliberately untouched
post_deploy_watch: Next runs of decider/curmudgeon/curmudgeon-verify should log '[clone-hygiene] sparse: ... files materialized'. If any agent instead logs a fail-open message or behaves oddly around monitor/integrity/, revert that agent's invocation line — single-line rollback per agent. Tinker's next Mode 1 run should check decider + curmudgeon outputs for sparse-related anomalies.
rollback: Per-agent: delete the 1-3 invocation lines from the agent's prompt; existing clones recover via 'git sparse-checkout disable' or natural re-clone. Script removal is safe once no prompt references it.
